title: Wire notes editing entry points in detail view
description: Integrate notes editing into `ShoppingListDetailView` by showing an edit pencil on the existing Notes section when notes are present and adding a toolbar overflow action to create the first note when notes are empty.
acceptance_criteria: When `document.notes` is non-empty, the detail view renders the Notes section and includes a tappable `square.and.pencil` affordance in the section header.
When `document.notes` is empty, the leading Notes section is omitted.
The detail view's toolbar overflow menu includes an `Edit notes` action that presents the same sheet when notes are empty.
Saving from the sheet writes the edited notes back to the document and triggers the existing document write path.

handoff_summary.completed: All five acceptance criteria are met: Notes section shows pencil affordance when non-empty; tapping it presents EditNotesSheet; section is omitted when notes are empty; overflow menu exposes "Edit notes" when notes are empty; saving updates document.notes and triggers the existing write path.
handoff_summary.risks: ShoppingListHeaderView now has an optional onEdit param — Meals section call site passes none, so it is unaffected. The SourceKit module warning is a known false positive in the takt worktree and does not affect compilation.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify: pencil tap presents EditNotesSheet; save updates notes and persists; overflow "Edit notes" appears only when notes are absent; empty state omits Notes section.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListHeaderView.swift now has an extra optional parameter. Any sibling bead that also modifies ShoppingListHeaderView would conflict.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Added optional `onEdit: (() -> Void)?` to ShoppingListHeaderView rather than inlining a custom Notes header in the detail view. This keeps the section rendering consistent and avoids code duplication. The button is rendered after the collapse chevron, so both tap targets remain independent.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Unit tests for this bead would cover: (1) detail view shows pencil when notes non-empty, (2) overflow contains Edit notes only when notes empty, (3) save callback updates document.notes.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListHeaderView.swift now has an extra optional parameter. Any sibling bead that also modifies ShoppingListHeaderView would conflict.

execution_history.summary: Wired notes editing entry points into ShoppingListDetailView. Added a `square.and.pencil` affordance to the Notes section header (via an optional `onEdit` callback on ShoppingListHeaderView), an "Edit notes" overflow menu item when notes are empty, and an EditNotesSheet binding that writes back to `document.notes` and calls `save()`.
